name: Records module
description: One function checks all five files and their links against the parsed template.
advantages: Small and dependency free; the checks read well in one place.
disadvantages: Text rules such as the task-phrasing test are heuristic.

name: Template parser
description: Reads the template block line by line, mapping labelled fields to snake case keys and bare questions to stable keys.
disadvantages: Depends on the template keeping a parseable shape.

name: Layout rules
description: Matches files to component path globs and walks each module's imports.
disadvantages: Globs need upkeep as files move.

name: Selector class
description: A table-driven resolver with run-time registration and lazy import.
disadvantages: One more indirection when reading code.

name: Component harness
description: One folder per solution with cases, a scorer and implementations; the run command appends a stamped row.
advantages: Measures shipped code with no outside service.

name: Margin leaderboard
description: Compares latest results on the same case hash with a pass-rate margin and a spend tolerance.
disadvantages: Fixed margins are a rough stand-in for confidence intervals.

name: Rule groups
description: Numbered rules in groups over one loaded context, with plugins and waivers.
advantages: One place for every rule; fast.

name: Tracker tabs
description: Generated CSV tabs with kept tracking columns and a merge-by-key sheet sync.

name: Consumer command
description: Reads the consumer's registry and checks each row against the installed library.
disadvantages: The consumer keeps its registry in the library's shape.

name: Documentation folder
description: Hand-written explanation and guides beside templates generated from the skill.
advantages: Needs no code and stays in step with the skill.
disadvantages: Prose can drift unless regenerated and reviewed.

name: Continuous integration workflow
description: A workflow that runs the tests, the structure check and the hygiene scan on every pull request and push, and the strict check on the default branch.
advantages: Every metric runs on every change without anyone remembering.
disadvantages: Ties the policy to one hosting service.
